diagnosticBoundary.firstDraft: The initial bridge draft expected catalog description/vendor to survive encoding. Existing wire code and prior tests deliberately omit those two text catalog fields. Only that expectation was corrected; all execution fields remain compared exactly.
diagnosticBoundary.firstDraftSourceFingerprint: The first draft was not frozen before correction; its failed report is diagnostic evidence only and is not counted as current verification.
diagnosticBoundary.lint: The first targeted lint rejected spreading a WorkflowStep-typed mock as a class instance. The harness now passes waitForEvent explicitly. All later checks use the accepted source.
diagnosticBoundary.functionLength: The new describe callback was factored into named test functions so new functions stay within 50 lines. The file was rerun after subsequent binding-specific assertions and mock bookkeeping fixes.
diagnosticBoundary.bindingSpies: The first binding-specific draft used vi.fn(existingSpy), which reused the same mock function and made all eight new cases fail their binding-count checks. Independent callback wrappers now keep per-binding spies distinct; all sixteen cases passed afterward. Production code was unchanged.

independentReview.boundary: Review was static before the final per-binding wrapper refinement. The parent runImpl, bridge and codec are real; Cloudflare, storage and notifications remain mocked.
